A person's clear permission for the app to use their data for a stated purpose.
Checks that confirm form values are acceptable before they are sent.

used_by: Routing for the registration address (not visible)

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the signup page
sections.what: Brings in the form tools, validation rules, auth hook, inputs, button and icons.
sections.why: Standard setup. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: RegisterPage (part 1)
sections.title: Form setup and password watcher
sections.what: Sets up the form with empty starting values and watches the password so the rule checklist can update live.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows requirements while typing. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: RegisterPage (part 2)
sections.title: Name, email and password fields
sections.what: Shows the name, email, password and confirm fields with their error messages, and a checklist of password rules.
sections.why: Likely reason: standard signup. The checklist gives quick feedback.
sections.watch_out: The checklist is display only. Enforcement depends on the registration rules.

sections.name: RegisterPage (part 3)
sections.title: Consent checkboxes section
sections.what: Shows a required core consent for processing health records, plus two optional consents for AI summaries and the AI chat assistant.
sections.why: The section title and comment say it follows DPDP consent rules.
sections.watch_out: The AI consents start unchecked. Changing that default would weaken the consent the user gives.

sections.name: RegisterPage (part 4)
sections.title: Terms, submit button and login link
sections.what: Shows the terms agreement with links to the terms and privacy pages, the create account button, and a link back to sign-in.
sections.why: Standard signup ending. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The terms and privacy links must point at real pages. Their addresses are not checked here.

sections.name: PasswordRequirement
sections.title: Password rule checklist item
sections.what: Shows one password rule with a check mark that turns green once the rule is met.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives visual feedback on each rule. Reason not stated in the code.

summary: The account creation page: name, email, password with live rules, consent checkboxes, terms agreement and a submit button.
purpose: Lets a new patient create an account and record their consent choices.
why: The code comments say the consent section follows India's DPDP Act 2023. Other reasons not stated.
how: Builds the form using the registration rules. Watches the password so the rule checklist updates as the user types. One core consent is required, while two AI consents are optional. Submitting calls the register function.
inputs: Full name, email, password, password confirmation, and checkboxes for consent and terms.
outputs: Calls the register function from the auth hook and shows validation errors.
risks: The password checklist only displays rules. Real enforcement is in the registration rules, which are not visible. The consent wording must match what the rules require.
debug: If submit does nothing, look for validation errors in the form. Check the registration rules for consent checks, and the register function in the auth hook.
